newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPAN DEALERS' BODY TO ANNOUNCE NOMURA PENALTIES.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN DEALERS' BODY TO ANNOUNCE NOMURA PENALTIES.

text.p: Japan Securities Dealers Association (JSDA) said on Friday that it would announce its penalties against scandal-hit Nomura Securities Co Ltd at 4.15 p.m. (0715 GMT).
JSDA, the self-regulatory body of the securities industry, also said it would announce measures to prevent the recurrence of the scandal, which involved payoffs to a corporate racketeer.
Industry sources said the JSDA was expected to levy a fine of 100 million yen on Nomura for its part in the scandal.
Separately, the Tokyo Stock Exchange said it would announce its penalties against Nomura at 0800 GMT.
